verdict.rationale: Jitsu covers the 'pipeline breaks' side of the story. A dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker lets failed events be replayed instead of lost, and Kafka buffers events and delivers them once a warehouse comes back online. Deduplication also makes it safe to resend the same data. Nothing in the evidence shows replaying archived history into a newly added destination or a general backfill tool. missing for 10: replay of archived or historical events into a new destination, a documented backfill workflow with time-range selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of replay.
